verdict.rationale: The only own-documented paper fallback is a passing note that the E-Verify certification can be submitted via a "paper form or electronic application" [fl-dor-docs-6], and Form RT-6 is named only within the electronic flow [fl-dor-docs-5]. The pack shows no mailing addresses, fax numbers, or paper-filing instructions for the core return/payment tasks. The email address [fl-dor-docs-7] and the support line with no number given [fl-dor-docs-15] are not a paper, fax, or mail rail, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: published mailing addresses, fax numbers, paper versions of return/registration/payment forms with filing instructions, explicit guidance for completing tasks when online systems are down.
